# SPD-021 — PostToolUse(Agent) completion overwrites a foreground member's run totals with final-request figures

## Brief
The Team card (SPD-010) and token accounting (SPD-013) need a member's run totals. For a foreground spawn, SubagentStop fires before PostToolUse(Agent, completed): hook_subagent_stop finds total_tokens NULL and stores the transcript sum (usage_json source transcript), then record_completion overwrites total_tokens and usage_json with the Agent tool's totalTokens and usage, which cover the final API request only. The member's cumulative tokens are lost and total_tokens means a different thing for foreground and background rows. Fix: record_completion keeps a transcript-sourced usage_json and total_tokens when present (and may still take totalDurationMs, totalToolUseCount, modelsUsed and resolvedModel), with a test for the foreground order.

Evidence: Claude Code hooks doc (code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks.md, Agent tool telemetry table): totalTokens is 'Token count from the subagent's final API request: input, output, and cache tokens combined. This isn't a total across the whole run', and 'totalTokens and usage cover the final request only'. Event order for a foreground spawn: docs/spikes/2026-09-12-ledger-database.md, Enforcement plan, fact 8. Code: bin/spud hook_subagent_stop (transcript sum only when total_tokens is NULL) and record_completion (unconditional UPDATE of total_tokens, duration_ms, tool_uses, usage_json). tests/test_hooks.py fixture: totalTokens 41831 equals its usage object's four keys summed, for a run with at least two requests. No live row is affected yet: the only rows with usage (Pompadour, Sarpo) are background spawns, source transcript.
